seo_title: Cost of Living in Sharjah 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Sharjah per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: The UAE's third-largest emirate, right next to Dubai: visa-free entry for 90 days, zero income tax and noticeably more affordable rents. A 'dry' emirate — alcohol is banned, and the road to Dubai can get congested.
pros: Visa-free entry for 90 days for Russian citizens
High safety and a family-friendly atmosphere
All of Dubai's services and airports nearby
cons: Traffic jams on the Dubai highway at rush hour
More conservative norms and dress code

faq.question: Do Russians need a visa for Sharjah?
faq.answer: No, visa-free for up to 90 days on arrival. For living there, you get a residence visa, just like in Dubai.

faq.question: How much does it cost to live in Sharjah?
faq.answer: Cheaper than Dubai, especially rent, with zero income tax. See the exact budget in the calculator above.

faq.question: Which language is spoken in Sharjah?
faq.answer: Arabic is the official language, but English is used everywhere at work and in daily life.

faq.question: Can I pay with a Russian card in Sharjah?
faq.answer: No, Russian cards don't work. You need a foreign bank card or cash dirhams.

faq.question: What is the climate like in Sharjah?
faq.answer: Desert: very hot summers and warm, comfortable winters — the best season is November to March.

faq.question: Is it true that alcohol is banned in Sharjah?
faq.answer: Yes, Sharjah is a 'dry' emirate: the sale and consumption of alcohol are banned, unlike in Dubai.

reviews.text: I live in Sharjah and work in Dubai — the savings on rent are significant. The downsides are the morning traffic on the highway and the alcohol ban, so we head to the neighbouring emirate for that.
Sharjah is calm and family-friendly, cheaper than Dubai and safe. You need to get used to the more conservative norms, but all the services of a metropolis are right next door.
